quotes.text: Work harder on yourself than you do on your job.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: Don't wish it were easier. Wish you were better.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: We must all suffer one of two things: the pain of discipline or the pain of regret.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: You are the average of the five people you spend the most time with.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: Either you run the day or the day runs you.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: Time is more valuable than money. You can get more money, but you cannot get more time.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: If you don't like how things are, change it. You're not a tree.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: Formal education will make you a living; self-education will make you a fortune.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: Success is nothing more than a few simple disciplines practiced every day.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: Happiness is not something you postpone for the future; it is something you design for the present.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: The same wind blows on us all; the difference is in the set of the sail.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: If you go to work on your goals, your goals will go to work on you.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn
